200.title: NATO Authorizes AWACS Forward Deployment to Poland After Council Session
200.summary: ← Back to World World NATO Authorizes AWACS Forward Deployment to Poland After Council Session A Russian drone briefly crossed into Polish airspace, and Poland's military cleared it to be shot down before it turned east.
200.body: ← Back to World World NATO Authorizes AWACS Forward Deployment to Poland After Council Session A Russian drone briefly crossed into Polish airspace, and Poland's military cleared it to be shot down before it turned east. Alexus Grynkewich, NATO's top commander in Europe, has authorized sending an AWACS early-warning aircraft forward to Poland, an alliance spokesperson said, after Russian cruise missiles entered Polish airspace Nov. Pawel Zalewski, Poland's deputy defense minister, who represented Warsaw at the session, told reporters afterward that Poland would have use of the plane and a stronger chance to react to threats. Late Monday night, Poland's Operational Command said a Russian drone had briefly crossed into Poland's airspace while Russia was attacking targets in western Ukraine.

400.title: Poland meets 76 of 77 EU RFF targets, but offshore wind ports fall short
400.summary: Brussels, 20 November 2026 On Friday, the European Commission partially greenlighted Poland’s sixth and final payment request for €12.7 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility , the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU. The Commission found that Poland has satisfactorily completed 76 out of 77 milestones and targets set out in the Council Implementing Decision .
400.body: Brussels, 20 November 2026 On Friday, the European Commission partially greenlighted Poland’s sixth and final payment request for €12.7 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility , the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU. The Commission found that Poland has satisfactorily completed 76 out of 77 milestones and targets set out in the Council Implementing Decision . The payment to Poland for the already greenlighted milestones and targets can take place following the EFC’s positive opinion and the subsequent adoption of a payment decision by the Commission. With a view to the closure of the Recovery and Resilience Facility at the end of 2026, Members States had to implement all outstanding milestones and targets by the end of August 2026 and submit final payment requests by the end of September 2026.

500.body: Artificial Intelligence Anthropic Expands Enterprise Safeguards for Detecting AI Misuse EFS helps zero-retention customers spot Claude misuse spread across many requests while keeping conversation data in their own cloud. By Eduard Kovacs | November 24, 2026 (8:30 AM ET) Flipboard Reddit Whatsapp Whatsapp Email Anthropic on Monday announced the public beta of Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a system designed to help organizations detect malicious use of AI. Guide to securing enterprise coding agents Anthropic on Monday also published a guide to securing enterprise coding agents , with a focus on risks associated with privilege abuse, credential exposure, risky dependencies, prompt injection, and data exfiltration.
